system.description:
Your "Mesmerize" has a range of "6Sq". A short staff with a distinctive gemstone embedded at the tip, featuring swirling patterns. The waves emitted from the gemstone cause intense dizziness and hinder movement. Effective against undead and golems, this item was a staple among Enchanters skilled in cloud control since the game era.

Immature Dragon Orb [Core Material] (300G) + Cedar Wand (450G) + Exhausting Poison (Intermediate) (140G) ×2 + [Magic Catalyst 12] (150G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (630G)
